passage: A controlled study of 240 commuters found that real-time crowding information shifted riders away from the busiest trains, reducing peak crowding by 8 percent. Total ridership did not change, and the effect was strongest when the app suggested a specific train. The transit agency will expand the feature systemwide this winter.

keyPoints.text: Real-time train suggestions reduced peak crowding by 8% without reducing ridership.
The transit agency will expand the feature systemwide this winter.
The effect was strongest when the app recommended a specific train.

referenceAnswer: Real-time train suggestions reduced peak crowding 8% without lowering ridership, so the feature will expand systemwide.
